title: Density of a binary affine subspace
statement: Let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $a,x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The uniform probability density of the affine subspace $a+H$, evaluated at $x$, equals $\sum_{\gamma\in H^\perp}(-1)^{\langle\gamma,x+a\rangle}$, where $H^\perp$ is the orthogonal complement under the standard dot product over $\mathbb{F}_2$.
